assessment: This work constructed a population graph deep learning model using machine learning-generated imaging features and non-imaging clinical characteristics that were proven to be effective at predicting the survival of patients with early-stage NSCLC, which help us understand the imaging and non-imaging features in determining NSCLC populations with a high risk of recurrence, and the high predictive accuracy proves its novelty and significance.
